test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:

He sings good / among all the / contestants in / the singing competition.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase "He sings good" in part B.
 
• In English, "good" is an adjective, but here it should be an adverb modifying the verb "sings."
 
• The correct word to use is "well," as it is the adverb form of "good."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part B** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He sings well among all the contestants in the singing competition."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "contestants in"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "the singing competition"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "among all the"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part B.
